Delicious& fresh home cooked meal
Feb 2026 • Solo
Food was excellent. I ordered vegetable spring rolls in rice wrappers& dipping them in their sauce was delicious. I also ordered chicken with vegetables dish & chicken was very fresh, tender& delicious. Service was impeccable.& my food came quickly, first the spring rolls& then chicken dish..Home cooked to perfection meal. I had a cough& asked for another delicious ginger tea to take back to the hotel. The owner a lovely woman instead sent me away with the ginger in a heart filled container with limes, & tea. They didn’t want to charge me, but I gave a “ tip” I had picked this restaurant out, but my hotel confirmed it was great food& family run. Thank you for a delicious dinner. One of the best in Vietnam& very affordable.

Delicious food, attentive service and good value!
Jan 2026 • Couples
This family restaurant in Hue City is delightful in every way. On the 2nd floor of a family home, it is warm and welcoming with its bright decor. The freshly made dishes are delicious. The morning glory is perfectly cooked just the right amount time and beautifully seasoned. The owner helped us make selections and gave us tips for eating the food. The meals are very reasonably priced and an excellent value. I highly recommend Family Home and Restaurant in Hue City.
